name: audioextender
description: A local macOS command-line tool that analyzes an existing track, selects strong beat-aligned phrases near the beginning and end, and exports a stereo WAV with a DJ-friendly intro and outro. The full original track remains present between the added sections.

scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:js && npm run coverage:python
scripts.coverage:python: .venv/bin/python -m coverage erase && .venv/bin/python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && .venv/bin/python -m coverage report -m && .venv/bin/python -m coverage json && .venv/bin/python -m coverage lcov -o coverage/lcov-python.info
